description:

- ARCHITECTURE.md §2.5, §3.3, §3.4, §12 v0.4 reflect the shipped shape (handle format, await semantics, oversized auto-dispatch behavior, lernie dispatch worker subcommand).
- §11 deferred-list updated: oversized-output auto-dispatch removed (now shipped) if it was on the v0.4-deferred list.
- TAXONOMY/PRINCIPLES updated if any new terms of art are introduced (e.g. handle as a structural term).
- Default template/providers.yaml roles.worker.tools list documented.
Close when grep for retired/aspirational language is clean and §2.5 + §3.3 read as descriptive of shipped behavior, not speculative.
title: Gate: docs up to date (v0.4 epic)
